title: sibara angelorum
intro: Sibara angelorum, commonly known as Angel's Tears, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sibara angelorum include reducing pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
